channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League and was the only Florida city selected for the honor this year.

item.title: Juno Beach residents demand fence replacement at JB-7 beach access as town faces thousands in costs
item.description: A missing fence at the JB-7 public beach walkway in Juno Beach has sparked conflict between Colony Condos residents and beachgoers who are cutting through private property. The town removed the old fence in 2023 for safety reasons.

item.title: Breast cancer patient's insurance denies reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, had her breast reconstruction surgery denied by Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield less than 24 hours before it was scheduled. The insurer said the GalaFlex mesh procedure is still considered investigational.

item.title: Boca Raton Community High School band to march in National Independence Day Parade
item.description: The Boca Raton Community High School band earned a spot in Washington, D.C.'s National Independence Day Parade, representing the entire state of Florida. The students will march on July 4 at 10:30 a.m.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs up 4% this year as inflation hits holiday staples
item.description: A Fourth of July cookout for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from last year, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey. Ground beef, buns and strawberries saw the biggest price increases.

item.title: Palm Beach County schools earn third straight A rating from state
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County received an A rating from the state for the third year in a row. The district also achieved a record 93.5% graduation rate.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman dies in home fire days before her birthday
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, died Monday in a fire at her Hobe Sound home. Friends launched a fundraiser to help her fiance Mark rebuild after the flames destroyed their belongings.

item.title: Juno Beach fence dispute at JB-7 beach access could cost town thousands
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos say beachgoers are cutting through their private property at the JB-7 public walkway since the town removed the old fence in 2023. The town council will take up the fence question in budget discussions on July 15.

item.title: Port St. Lucie moves forward with Midway Road expansion and Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to FDOT for a partial interchange on the Turnpike. The $95 million Midway Road Widening Project is already underway.

item.title: West Palm Beach considers elevated self-driving transit connecting downtown to airport
item.description: California-based Glydways will present a proposal to Palm Beach County commissioners Tuesday for an elevated network of autonomous vehicles connecting downtown West Palm Beach to President Donald J. Trump International Airport.

item.title: Martin County maritime teams prepare for Fourth of July boaters on the water
item.description: Hundreds of boaters are hitting the waterways in Martin County to celebrate the Fourth of July weekend. The Martin County Maritime Response Unit will have two boats with medics on standby in the north and south.

item.title: Port St. Lucie moves forward with Midway Road widening and Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation to assist with a partial interchange on the Turnpike at Midway Road.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes Monday for $3 million renovation, slip capacity nearly doubles
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a year-long $3 million renovation that will nearly double its capacity from 18 to 44 slips for motorized and.

item.title: West Palm Beach autonomous elevated transit system proposed to connect downtown to airport
item.description: California-based Glydways is proposing an elevated network of self-driving vehicles that would connect downtown West Palm Beach to President Donald J. Trump International Airport, with the trip potentially taking less than 10 minutes.

item.title: Delray Beach golf training center Tee Box opening July 17 after $90,000 contractor setback
item.description: Tom Molen's Tee Box, a new virtual golf training and performance center near Delray Beach along Jog Road south of Linton Boulevard, will open July 17 after a three-month delay caused by contractor problems.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman dies in Monday house fire as community raises funds for fiance
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside the couple's Hobe Sound home. Preliminary findings from the sheriff's office point to an electrical issue as a possible cause.

item.title: Lantana veteran gets roof fixed, lien removed after WPTV steps in
item.description: Stephen McCoy, a disabled and retired veteran in Lantana, had a nearly $7,000 lien removed from his home and his roof repairs completed after WPTV contacted the contractor.

item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football program is working hard this summer with a clear goal: winning a state championship during the 2026 fall season. item.description: Martin County Maritime Response Unit will have two boats with medics on standby in the north and south parts of the county as hundreds of boaters celebrate the holiday weekend.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk comments
item.description: The Martin County School Board filed court papers Thursday opposing an administrative law judge's recommendation to reinstate Matt Theobald, a Spectrum Academy teacher suspended after social media comments about Charlie Kirk.

item.title: Hobe Sound community supports man who lost fiancé in deadly home fire
item.description: Friends have launched a fundraiser to help Mark rebuild after a fire destroyed his and his fiancé Misty Dawn White's home in Hobe Sound earlier this week.

item.description: Stephen McCoy, a disabled and retired veteran in Lantana, turned to WPTV after a roofing contractor left unfinished repairs and a nearly $7,000 lien on his home.

item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors will celebrate Independence Day with a full day of family-friendly activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.

item.title: St. Petersburg selects $8.1 billion vision to redevelop Tropicana Field site
item.description: Mayor Ken Welch chose a proposal led by Blake Investment Partners and Related Group to transform acres of stadium parking and public land into a mixed-use district with housing, hotels, cultural institutions and a 13-acre central park.

item.title: DeSantis allies accuse Lieutenant Governor's wife of running anonymous accounts attacking Governor
item.description: Multiple social media accounts were deactivated Friday after prominent veterans of Governor Ron DeSantis' communications team alleged the accounts were operated.

item.title: Secretary of State asks court to keep Republican candidate off ballot after filing disaster
item.description: Secretary of State Cord Byrd is asking courts to keep Paula Stark off the ballot after she failed to properly submit required paperwork less than 30 minutes before the noon qualifying deadline on June 12.
